issue.title: test_ace_and_lsp_wait_prose_replacement_ranges_match is over the flake baseline with no bead, blocking check-full's last gate
issue.description:
FOUND BY the 0g5 family while consuming `just check-full` monitor nzzvrzg6x73s for approved plan plan:202608/remove_memory_proposals.md. Lint, SASE validation, committed plans, the full pytest suite, and `just test-cost` all passed. Failure is only `just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake`: this wait-prose ACE/LSP parity node is not in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt. NOT caused by the memory-proposal removal: the smoking-gun record is workspace sase_19 at head d4327985d with a one-failure full-lane run whose change set is plan-gate tests only.

`just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` is the last gate of `just check-full`, so an undeclared node here blocks every landing agent that reaches it.

The test starts a real `sase-xprompt-lsp` subprocess via LspSession and asserts that `%wait:co` yields a `coder` insertion whose textEdit range matches ACE `classify_directive_completion`. Isolated serial rerun on this tree passed in 1.57s (call 0.06s). Root cause is not proven: ready bug sase-v6 documents rust-lsp-install copying from the wrong cargo target dir and exiting 0 (stale/missing binary), and in-progress epic sase-rj owns the ACE/LSP directive-completion contract and this parity test.

---

## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/test_xprompt_directive_completion_parity.py::test_ace_and_lsp_wait_prose_replacement_ranges_match`
- **Repro:** `just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake`; isolated `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_xprompt_directive_completion_parity.py::test_ace_and_lsp_wait_prose_replacement_ranges_match` passes (1 passed, 1.57s)

Two eligible full-lane records (schema 2, at most 5 failures) on unrelated dirty trees, with a later full run that passed the node:

1. 20260829T145515Z-fbd37ca3da3b-1420141-full-run.json (sase_12, head fbd37ca3da3b, 15:01Z): 3 failures, of which wait-prose is the only one unrelated to the in-progress memory-proposal deletion.
2. 20260829T152156Z-d4327985d50f-1847978-full-run.json (sase_19, head d4327985d50f, 15:28Z): sole failure is wait-prose; changed files are tests/_plan_gate_fixtures.py and two plan-gate test modules.

This check-full's test-cost lane passed the node. No entry in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt. No serial reproduction of the failure on this tree.
